name: Nurse no Oku-san wa Suki Desu ka? ~Sewayaki Oba-chan Kanraku♡~
original_name: ナースの奥さんは好きですか？～世話焼きオバちゃん陥落♡～
source:
My friend's mother, Kazuyo Iruma, always took care of me.
She was a married woman and worked busily as a nurse.

Within the eyes of the protagonist, Kazuyo was simply his friend's mother but now...a story of something opposite unfolds....

"Ahaha, an old woman like me as your partner, what are you saying~"
With the protagonist passionately asking her continuously, Kazuyo who didn't take him seriously finally crossed the line...

The married nurse who did what's not supposed to be done ultimately forgets her family and spirals into her new-found addiction with her son's friend.

[Loosely Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=842279]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
我朋友的母亲入间和世一直很照顾我。
她是一名已婚妇女，担任护士，工作繁忙。

在主角眼中，和世只是他朋友的母亲，但现在……相反的故事正在展开……

“啊哈哈，我一个老女人当你的搭档，你在说什么啊~”
在主角热情地不断追问下，不以为然的和世终于越界了……

这位已婚护士做了不该做的事，最终忘记了她的家人，并陷入了对儿子朋友的新瘾。

[大致翻译自 [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=842279]Getchu[/url]]
